title: "Research"

```{python}
#| output: asis
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from _helpers import load, render_paper

pubs = load("publications")

def section(heading: str, items: list, intro: str = ""):
    if not items:
        return
    print(f"\n## {heading}\n")
    if intro:
        print(intro + "\n")
    for p in items:
        if p.get("skip_website"):
            continue
        print(render_paper(p))

section("Publications", pubs.get("published", []))
section("Under Review", pubs.get("under_review", []))
section("Working Papers", pubs.get("working", []))
section("Work in Progress", pubs.get("in_progress", []))
```
